source_text: Caleb filius Iephonne: Octoginta quinque annorum sum; da mihi montem Hebron. Fides non senescit. Enacim expellendi — gigantes superbiae.
pass_a_gloss: Caleb son of-Jephunneh: Eighty five of-years I-am; give to-me mountain Hebron. Faith not grows-old. Anakim to-be-driven-out — giants of-pride.
pass_b_english: [[Caleb son of Jephunneh: I am eighty-five; give me the hill country of Hebron >> Bible:Joshua 14:6-12]]. Faith does not age. The Anakim — pride’s giants — must be driven out.
